description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to Montgomery inversion, including calculation of modular inverses and Montgomery parameters, used in elliptic curve cryptography within the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: bn_neg_inv_mod_r_u64
methods.description: Calculates the negative modular inverse of n modulo r, used in Montgomery multiplication.

methods.name: bn_mont_n0
methods.description: Computes the Montgomery parameter n0 for a given BIGNUM n, used in Montgomery reduction.

methods.name: bn_mod_exp_base_2_consttime
methods.description: Performs a constant-time modular exponentiation with base 2.
